_meta.purpose: E-E-A-T author attribution. Google's 2026 page-level authority evaluation rewards real, named, credible authorship. Every article attaches an author from here plus a 'Reviewed by' human.
_meta.instructions: FILL IN with your real team. At least one entry MUST be a real, named human with genuine local EV expertise (not a pseudonym). Put author photos in public/images/authors/. Do NOT publish with placeholder values — a real corrections/editorial page + named humans are part of what keeps the site indexed and sellable.

authors.name: REPLACE — real full name (e.g. Ankur Mittal)
authors.role: REPLACE — e.g. Founder & Lead EV Advisor, EV Chandigarh
authors.bio: REPLACE — 1-2 specific, true sentences. Mention real credentials: years in EV retail, Tricity focus, hands-on experience with these exact models, number of customers served. This text is read by Google AND by prospective buyers, so make it concrete and credible, not generic.

authors.name: REPLACE — a second real person if available (optional, strengthens E-E-A-T)
authors.role: REPLACE — e.g. Service Head / Senior Technician

publisher.name: EV Chandigarh
publisher.legal_entity: REPLACE — registered business name (e.g. SellnShip / Gauranga Traders)
publisher.address: REPLACE — showroom address in the Tricity
publisher.whatsapp: REPLACE — number used for the WhatsApp pre-fill CTAs
publisher.note: This block also feeds the Organization schema on the About page and the contact CTAs.
